caseName: Canton Poultry, Inc. v. Doyle Conner
caseNameFull: CANTON POULTRY, INC., Et Al. v. CONNER, COMMISSIONER OF AGRICULTURE OF FLORIDA
attorneys: Homer S. Durden, Jr., for appellants., Earl Faircloth, Attorney General of Florida, and Robert A. Chastain, Assistant Attorney General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The judgment is vacated and the case remanded to the District Court so that it may enter a fresh decree from which a timely appeal may be taken to the Court of Appeals. Pennsylvania Public Utility Comm’n v. Pennsylvania R. Co., 382 U. S. 281, 282.
